headline: Hearing on Zayo petition to install underground fiber optic conduit across Stafford Street.
summary: One petition is on the agenda, filed by Zayo. It covers underground fiber optic facilities in the public way near 300 Stafford Street.
items: Zayo petition to install and maintain underground fiber optic telecommunication facilities in the public way
Trench across Stafford St from utility pole #40T and install one 2-inch conduit about 80 feet north to the property line of 271 Carew St in Springfield, MA
plain_text:
Board of Public Works                                          1                                       Printed 4/22/2025 
 
 
                         BOARD OF PUBLIC WORKS       
  
                                Hearings Meeting Agenda 
   
  
I hereby notify you that the following items of business have been filed with this office and can 
be acted upon at the meeting of the Board of Public Works Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 
3:30 PM.  
  
City Clerk  
 
Location 
300 Stafford Street 
 
Petitions 
To install and maintain fiber optic telecommunication facilities in the public way, consisting of 
underground facilities. Starting at Utility pole#40T, trench across Stafford St and install (1) 2” 
conduit +/- 80’ northerly to the property line “271 Carew St in Springfield, MA. 
 1. Zayo -300 Stafford Street
